title: lepidium virginicum var. centrali-americanum
intro: Lepidium virginicum var. centrali-americanum, commonly known as American cress or wild mustard, is a variant of the cress plant native to the Americas. It is used for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, aiding in the prevention of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. Lepidium virginicum var. centrali-americanum contains bioactive constituents such as glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
